tsa.pageTitle: Can I bring juice on a plane?

travelTips: Juice is subject to the 3-1-1 liquids rule. Carry-on containers must be 3.4 oz (100 ml) or less.

faq.question: Is juice allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: Juice is restricted in carry-on luggage. Juice is subject to the 3-1-1 liquids rule. Carry-on containers must be 3.4 oz (100 ml) or less.

faq.question: Can you pack juice in checked baggage?
faq.answer: Yes, Juice is allowed in checked bags. Juice is allowed in checked baggage in any size.
